links.outcome: Robustness of model classifications to demographic descriptors in inputs, by model
links.effect: Flan-T5 models were more robust to demographic descriptors than other LLMs; GPT-4.1 and Gemma3 often misclassified inputs as "None." No numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: On external datasets, Flan-T5 models outperformed other LLMs (P < .001), and were more robust to demographic descriptors, while GPT-4.1 and Gemma3 often misclassified inputs as "None."

links.outcome: Macro-F1 on internal test split versus external dataset
links.effect: Barrier detection Macro-F1 fell from 0.83 (test) to 0.71 (external); risk stratification fell from 0.79 to 0.57.
links.quote: Flan-T5-xl achieved the best barrier detection (Macro-F1 = 0.83 test/0.71 external), and Flan-T5-large excelled in risk stratification (0.79/0.57).

unlisted_practices: Co-construction committee of people with HIV and providers to define annotation categories

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks fine-tuned and proprietary LLMs for identifying ART adherence barriers and risk levels from patient messages on annotated datasets, including fairness and error analyses, but does not test a specific organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
